items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Sousa had honored him by doing one of his marches

ctx.x: What did he do, was that his living? Was he a teacher by profession?

Well, he was a teacher by profession, a professional allowed musician. A tremendous musician and he allowed us a certain amount of leniency. There was, I mean there's baseball and all those things and he was patient enough, he called the time but he was patient enough to give you a break of 5 or 10 minutes sun is before it happened. You know, sunshine shining, too. And he was a tremendous teacher. He has written some things, Sousa had honored him by doing one of his marches and I can't remember just what one of…
Do you know where he was educated at all?
